I couldn't do this research. My first attempt to fetch the sources failed with a message saying I had no tool calls left for this turn. That means I couldn't read Enduring Word, Bible Hub (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit), Precept Austin, NET Bible, New Advent or any of the other approved sites.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, give a URL for every point, and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. Since I read no pages, any verse notes I wrote now would break those rules, so I haven't written any.

**Next step:** ask again in a new message and the tools should be available. I'd start with these pages:
- **Traditional reading, verse by verse:** Enduring Word (Psalm 20); Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary on Bible Hub or StudyLight; Precept Austin's Psalm 20 page; Spurgeon's *Treasury of David* (on Spurgeon.org or StudyLight).
- **Where Protestant traditions differ:** Wesley's Notes (wesley.nnu.edu), Ligonier or The Gospel Coalition (Reformed), Desiring God or GTY (Baptist), and LCMS or 1517 (Lutheran). These are most likely to matter on v. 6 (the "anointed" king and Christ) and v. 7 (trusting the Lord's name).
- **Other views:**
  - NET Bible notes on the Hebrew of vv. 3, 5 and 9.
  - Augustine's commentary on New Advent. Older Catholic Bibles number this Psalm 19.
  - Gotquestions.org on v. 4 ("the desires of your heart"), the verse most often used in prosperity teaching.
